description:
AnyDB is a workspace for records, documents, files, and business processes. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your AnyDB account so you can find, create, update, copy, and move records, search their content by meaning, and upload or download files without leaving the conversation.

You can also build and adjust AnyDB solutions: define record types with fields, layouts, and formulas; set up filtered views and reports; share records and forms; add comments; review and restore earlier record versions; and automate work with event-driven workflows.

Sign in with your AnyDB account. The plugin can only see and change what your AnyDB permissions allow.

defaultPrompt: What's waiting in my inbox, and which items look most urgent?
